title: Give the accounting sync job retries and a failure alert
summary: A job that lands in failed_jobs after one 502 gets $tries, backoff() and failed(), and stops retrying on a 4xx.

files.content:
<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Models\Invoice;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

class SyncInvoiceToAccounting implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(public Invoice $invoice)
    {
    }

    public function handle(): void
    {
        Http::withToken(config('services.accounting.token'))
            ->post('https://accounting.example.com/api/invoices', [
                'number' => $this->invoice->number,
                'amount' => $this->invoice->amount,
            ])
            ->throw();
    }
}

turns.user: the job that pushes invoices to accounting goes straight to failed_jobs if they 502 once. add some retries. someone ran the worker with --tries=0 once and it looped forever, so not that. and ping slack if it finally gives up

assistant.body: Great question! The default for --tries on queue:work is 1, so a single failure is final. Rather than touch the worker, let's put the count on the job itself. A job's $tries wins over the worker's --tries.

Here's the plan. $tries = 5 allows up to five attempts, and backoff() waits 10 seconds, then a minute, then five. When there are more attempts than entries, the last one is reused. After the fifth failure failed() runs and posts to Slack. Note: throw() only raises on a 5xx, so a 4xx will not be retried for nothing.

turns.user: the ones with a negative amount get a 422 and we hit them 5 times, accounting complained. didnt you say 4xx doesnt retry?

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. throw() raises RequestException on a 4xx as well as a 5xx, so the 422 went out five times. Sending a 4xx again gets the same answer, so fail() now ends the job on the spot. fail() still calls failed(), so Slack hears about it.

turns.user: oh wait they rate limit with 429 sometimes. that one does go through if you wait, so retry it

assistant.body: Sure. 429 comes out of the fail() condition and falls through to throw(), so it waits out backoff() like a 5xx.
